build_gemma2_encoder: build a Gemma2 text encoder model that extracts hidden states as conditioning for SANA cross-attention layers
create_gemma2_attention: create a Gemma2Attention module with alternating global and sliding-window attention for efficient long-sequence processing
run_gemma2_forward: run a Gemma2Model forward pass to encode tokenized text and return final hidden states
load_gemma2_weights: load Gemma2 model weights with support for stacked parameter sharding and tensor parallelism
test_gemma2_mlp: test a Gemma2MLP module with GeGLU activation and merged gate/up projection layers
